about: The reference setup: Andrii Shramko's own board (HGLRC F405 8S V2 + Flycolor X-Cross HV3 160A BLHeli_32, 6S LiPo), firmware 1.1.1, as read back on 2026-10-20. tools/make_board_config.py writes the build part into a board's config.h, tools/check_reference.py compares a board with it. docs/settings.md explains every value.

adapt_to_your_hardware.autostart_cells: the series cell count of YOUR battery (reference: 6 = 6S). A wrong count makes the 3.30 V/cell cut-off wrong.
adapt_to_your_hardware.autostart_motors: bitmask of the outputs that carry YOUR ESC signal: 1 = output 1, 15 = outputs 1-4 (reference: one ESC on output 1; the HGLRC cable joins outputs 1-4). On a 4-in-1 ESC, 15 spins all four motors.
adapt_to_your_hardware.ESC_SENSOR: on only when the ESC's TX pad is wired to a UART RX pad of the board (reference: yes, UART5 RX). That UART needs the ESC_SENSOR function (1024).
adapt_to_your_hardware.vbat_scale: calibrate on YOUR board; never copy (reference unit: 149, its config default 210 read 40.5 % high).
